title: Downtown Green Bay in 1930
caption: Downtown Green Bay in 1930, the year before Bill was born there.
alt: Historic Green Bay storefronts and street traffic, viewed south from Main Street in 1930.
author: J. Aregi / Wisconsin Historical Society
representation: Publisher’s downloadable JPEG, preserved byte for byte
rightsNote: Wisconsin Historical Society catalog W013SP4, legacy image WHi 31928, PF Green Bay.257. The source dates the photograph to 1930 and labels it No Copyright - United States.

title: Rural Grant County during the Dust Bowl
caption: Rural Grant County in July 1936—the county where Bill spent part of his childhood. This is a regional view, rather than an identified Stegmeier home.
alt: A 1936 Grant County farm framed by trees killed by drought and grasshoppers.
author: Arthur Rothstein / Library of Congress
representation: Library of Congress large service JPEG, preserved byte for byte
rightsNote: FSA/OWI collection, LC-USF34-005112-D; digital ID fsa.8b28112. The original catalog locates this farm only in Grant County. No claim is made that it is Bill’s family home or in the town of Elgin.

title: Hennepin Avenue at Seventh Street
caption: Minneapolis on November 8, 1951, about six weeks before Bill entered the Marines there.
alt: Buses, cars, storefronts and theater signs at Hennepin Avenue and Seventh Street in Minneapolis in 1951.
author: Michael Donovan
representation: 640-pixel source JPEG downloaded through the source page, preserved byte for byte
rightsNote: The Wikimedia Commons record dates this photograph to November 8, 1951, and credits Michael Donovan under CC BY-SA 2.0. It records a verified Flickr license check made when the image was copied in 2013.

title: Yuma’s riverfront and bridges
caption: Yuma’s riverfront on October 15, 1953, the same year Bill and Jean married in the city.
alt: An October 1953 aerial view of Yuma’s riverfront, water-treatment works and Colorado River bridges.
author: Emil Eger / Library of Congress, HAER
representation: Library of Congress large service JPEG, preserved byte for byte
rightsNote: HAER ARIZ,14-YUMA.V,1--11; digital ID hhh.az0293/photos.041618p. The original catalog dates Emil Eger’s photograph to October 15, 1953. LOC notes that copied photographs may have rights restrictions; this historical reproduction is a contextual illustration in the biography and grants no additional reuse rights.
credit: Emil Eger / Library of Congress, HAER

title: A training demonstration at Camp Pendleton
caption: Marines watching a training demonstration at Camp Pendleton in 1952, during Bill’s service years.
alt: A 1952 color photograph of Marines watching a demonstration across the hills and training grounds at Camp Pendleton.
author: USMC Archives / Ronald Trayer Collection
representation: USMC Archives published 640-pixel preview, preserved byte for byte
rightsNote: Final Protective Line Demonstration, Camp Pendleton, 1952, Ronald Trayer Collection COLL/5635, Archives Branch, Marine Corps History Division. The publisher identifies it as an official USMC photograph and displays a CC BY 2.0 license. It illustrates the base during his service; Bill is not identified in the photograph.

title: Colorado A&M’s campus from the air
caption: The Fort Collins campus in May 1955, when the university was known as Colorado A&M. Bill’s exact enrollment and degree dates remain unconfirmed.
alt: An aerial view from the north of Colorado A&M’s campus in May 1955, including the Oval and Old Main.
author: CSU Libraries, University Historic Photograph Collection
representation: Archive’s downloadable JPEG, preserved byte for byte
rightsNote: Unidentified photographer; UHPC_B6184G, University Historic Photograph Collection, Series 16, Campus Buildings and Scenes. The catalog dates the image May 1955 and states that Colorado State University owns the rights. Contextual historical illustration; no broader reuse license is asserted.

title: South Dakota State’s campus in 1968
caption: South Dakota State’s campus in October 1968, shortly before the February 1969 report documenting Bill’s return to graduate study.
alt: Aerial view looking north across South Dakota State University’s Brookings campus in October 1968.
author: South Dakota State University, Hilton M. Briggs Library
representation: Publisher’s archive preview, preserved byte for byte
rightsNote: Open PRAIRIE Aerial Photographs collection, identifier 1968-1599-PA01. Creation date is October 1968; the repository’s copyright notice is dated 2015, which is not the exposure date. Contextual historical illustration; no broader reuse rights are granted.

title: The Garden City station before Bill’s arrival
caption: The Garden City station in its 1957 anniversary history, published one year before Bill arrived. The photograph’s exact date is unrecorded.
alt: Black-and-white aerial photograph of the Garden City Branch Experiment Station and its surrounding fields, reproduced in a 1957 station history.
author: Kansas State University
representation: Raster from PDF page 36, image 0, extracted with pdfimages and losslessly encoded as PNG
rightsNote: Kansas Report 7, Fifty Years of Progress: Garden City Branch, Kansas Agricultural Experiment Station (June 1957), back-cover photograph. Publication year is documented; exposure date is not stated. Contextual illustration from the original station history; copyright remains with the publisher.

title: The Hays station from the air
caption: The Hays station in a September 1984 brochure, during Bill’s years there. The photograph’s exact date is unrecorded.
alt: Color aerial photograph of the Hays experiment station from a brochure published in September 1984.
author: Kansas State University
representation: Composite raster from PDF page 3, image 1 (object 22), extracted with pdfimages and losslessly encoded as PNG
rightsNote: Fort Hays Branch Station, Special Publication, September 1984, PDF page 3. The upper photograph of the preserved composite is used for the web view. Publication date is established; exact exposure date is not given. Contextual illustration; copyright remains with the source publisher.
